home.realmless: World of Warcraft: Forever is realmless. There's no server to pick. Anyone can join us, wherever they are.
home.values.title: About Eldvik
home.values.social.title: Social first
home.values.social.body: We care about good company as much as good loot. It doesn't matter if you're new to the game or you've played for years.
home.values.raiding.title: Casual raiding
home.values.raiding.body: We raid together, but we don't chase parses or logs. Life outside the game comes first.

about.hero.title: About Eldvik
about.story.body: Eldvik is a Nordic guild for World of Warcraft: Forever. We're from Sweden, Norway and Denmark. We think the journey matters more than the destination, that dungeons are better with people you like, and that nobody should feel dumb for asking a question. We raid, but we don't chase logs. Work and everyday life come first, and we plan raiding around that.
about.values.title: What we value
about.values.item1.title: Respect
about.values.item1.body: You'll be treated with respect from day one, whatever you play and however experienced you are.
about.values.item2.title: Show up when you can
about.values.item2.body: Life comes first. Log in when you're able. Nobody needs to be online every night.
about.values.item3.title: Ask anything
about.values.item3.body: There's no such thing as a stupid question here. We were all new once.
about.values.item4.title: No drama
about.values.item4.body: No logs, no parses, no elitism. Just people enjoying a game together.
about.closing.title: Want to know more?
recruitment.hero.title: Recruitment
recruitment.hero.lead: All classes and roles are welcome at Eldvik. We're social first, a Nordic guild from Sweden, Norway and Denmark, with no experience requirements. No logs, no parses, just good company and a willingness to show up.
recruitment.looking.title: What we're looking for
recruitment.looking.item1.title: Any class, any role
recruitment.looking.item2.title: Nordic at heart
recruitment.looking.item2.body: We're a Nordic guild, Swedish, Norwegian and Danish. We speak English when someone doesn't follow along.
recruitment.looking.item3.title: No experience needed
recruitment.looking.item3.body: New to raiding, or coming back after a break? That's fine. We don't check logs or ask about experience.
recruitment.schedule.title: Raid times
recruitment.schedule.body: Raid times will be announced closer to launch and when people have started to reach 60.
recruitment.loot.title: Loot
recruitment.loot.body: We will be using softreserve for loot while we raid.
recruitment.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
recruitment.faq.q1: What ruleset and faction do you play?
recruitment.faq.a1: PvP ruleset, and Alliance, though that's not fully confirmed yet.
recruitment.faq.q2: Is there a server I need to be on?
recruitment.faq.a2: No. World of Warcraft: Forever doesn't have separate realms, so there's nothing to pick and nowhere to transfer from.
recruitment.faq.q3: How much do I need to play?
recruitment.faq.a3: As much or as little as you like outside of raid nights. We don't track playtime. We're a grown up guild with jobs, studies and families.
recruitment.faq.a4: No. Plenty of members are here for the social side and don't raid at all.
recruitment.faq.q5: Do I have to speak on voice chat?
recruitment.faq.a5: No, but most people do during raids because it's easier to coordinate. Outside of raids it's optional.
recruitment.faq.a6: No. We don't check logs or ask about experience.
recruitment.faq.a7: Mostly English, since we're Swedish, Norwegian and Danish players together. Use whichever you're comfortable with.
recruitment.closing.title: How to apply
recruitment.closing.body: The Join page walks through it, or you can go straight to our Discord.
join.hero.title: Join Eldvik
join.hero.lead: Applying takes a few minutes. Here's how it works.
join.step1.title: Join our Discord
join.step1.body: This is where we talk, plan raids and hang out. Most of the guild is there most days.
join.step2.title: Go to #apply-to-eldvik
join.step2.body: Start a new post in the #apply-to-eldvik forum channel. It doesn't need to be long.
join.step3.title: Post a short introduction
join.step3.body: Say where you're from, what you like to play, and anything else you want us to know. An officer will reply.
join.reassurance: It doesn't have to be long. A few sentences is enough.
join.launchNote: Raid schedule will be announced as launch (November 4, 2026) gets closer. Join the Discord now to be part of the planning.
